US11297348B2.title: Implicit transform settings for coding a block of pixels

E1_implicit.description: the transform is derived implicitly, without explicit signalling
E1_implicit.evidence: Claim 1: 'deriving a transform setting based on a block processing setting for the block of pixels' and 'wherein deriving the transform setting comprises selecting a transform mode from a plurality of transform modes based on the block processing setting'. The transform mode is derived, not signalled.

E3_per_axis.description: the horizontal and the vertical axis are predicted separately
E3_per_axis.evidence: Claim 1 and claim 10: 'the position is used to determine a transform type from the set of transform types for a horizontal transform, and when the horizontal splitting orientation is used, the position is used to determine the transform type for a vertical transform'. The horizontal and the vertical transform are chosen separately, but from the partitioning orientation of the block and the position of the transformed sub-block, not from the geometry of the neighbourhood.

E2_geometry.description: the derivation reads the geometry of a neighbourhood of reconstructed samples

E4_margin.description: the encoder may take a less optimal transform, at a rate-distortion cost, to avoid signalling the correction

E5_learned.description: the prediction comes from a trained or learned model

E6_correction.description: a correction is signalled relative to a prediction

US11297348B2.notes: The claim is about a sub-block transform: the transform type is a function of the SBT partitioning, the sub-block's position and the block's size. There is no geometry of reconstructed samples, no learned model, and no rate-distortion margin in the claims.

US11134275B2.title: Method and apparatus for performing primary transform based on filtering of blocks

E1_implicit.description: the transform is derived implicitly, without explicit signalling
E1_implicit.evidence: Claim 1: 'in response to determining that the filtering process is applied on the current block, performing, based on the filtering process, a primary transform for a transform block that is partitioned from the current block'. The decoder performs the transform; the transform mode is not signalled per block.

E2_geometry.description: the derivation reads the geometry of a neighbourhood of reconstructed samples
E2_geometry.evidence: Claim 1: 'the filtering process adjusts inter prediction samples of the current block based on neighboring reconstructed samples of the current block'. The neighbouring reconstructed samples are read, but they are used to filter the prediction, and the transform is chosen from the filtering mode and the size of the block, rather than from the geometry of the samples.

E3_per_axis.description: the horizontal and the vertical axis are predicted separately
E3_per_axis.evidence: Claim 3: 'the primary transform is a type - 7 discrete sine transform ( DST - 7 ) mode for a horizontal transform that is applied to the transform block responsive to a width of the current block being smaller than or equal to a threshold value, the primary transform is the DST - 7 mode for a vertical transform that is applied to the transform block responsive to a height of the current block being smaller than or equal to the threshold value'. The horizontal and the vertical transforms are chosen separately, but each is a function of the block's width or height, not of a prediction.

E4_margin.description: the encoder may take a less optimal transform, at a rate-distortion cost, to avoid signalling the correction

E5_learned.description: the prediction comes from a trained or learned model

E6_correction.description: a correction is signalled relative to a prediction

US20240040151A1.notes: Priority 2022-07-28, so this is the most recent reference. It derives the transform type, and a range of other syntax elements, from the pattern of the decoded coefficients and their correlation with the neighbouring blocks, and it omits the signalling when the inferred value matches a default. The claims do not reach the neighbouring blocks: claim 7 reads the block's own coefficient pattern, "determining a pattern of quantized transform coefficients of the transform unit based on coefficient values of the transform unit". The description is wider than the claims, and anticipation is judged on the claims, so the element is not recorded as disclosed. The omission is a match against a default rather than a rate-distortion trade.
